script: South Florida clubs: this is Cancha for Clubs. Your club gets a free page, with your crest, league and city. Post an opening, and players ask to join. Get featured on our Instagram, with your club tagged. When you're ready, we find local sponsors that fit your club. We also build your media kit, for free. Claim your club. Send us a message on Instagram, at We Are Cancha.
caption:
Introducing Cancha for Clubs ⚽️

For adult clubs in Miami-Dade and Broward:

✅ A free club page in the Cancha app: crest, league, city
✅ Post an opening (a keeper, a sub, a tryout night) and players ask to join
✅ Club spotlights on our Instagram, with your club tagged
✅ A free media kit, and help finding local sponsors that fit your club when you're ready

Run a club? DM us your club name and we'll set up your page.

Tag a club that should be on Cancha 👇

App screens show an example post. Club crests as listed in the Cancha directory; a listing is not a partnership or endorsement.
